protocol_deviations.description: Before the implementation commit was pinned, the theorem-backed K↔O/cross-completion recoding audits and the Section 8 finite n=8/n=4 diagnostic helper were executed while validating the harness. No 72-case primary cap matrix or table artifact was run or inspected, no protocol choice or scientific logic was changed in response, and all of these controls/diagnostics are rerun canonically after the pinned implementation. This procedural deviation is retained rather than hidden.
